title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1970-06-24
source: recorded by J.Cooper: Hitachi trq-222 stereo casstte recoder using 2 hitachi mics and a 120 minute tape.

ai_review.summary: A three‑set powerhouse with a blistering 'Other One' captured on an audience tape of modest fidelity.
ai_review.review: The performance is described as tight, energetic and full of wow moments – especially the soaring 'Other One' and a punchy opening with 'Casey Jones'.  The recording sounds like an audience source from Portchester; it’s listenable but suffers from lower‑grade taping and occasional song cuts.  Overall the show shines despite the technical limitations.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical praise (70% weight) outweighs modest recording quality (30% weight), yielding a high overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Lower‑grade taping with some song cuts; drums are distinctive but overall mix is not crisp or balanced like a soundboard.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Three sets – electric opener, an acoustic middle set with the New Riders, and a high‑energy closing set.  The vibe is described as tight and powerful, with crowd energy feeding into the band.

band_member_comments.Drums: Drums are noted for their unmistakable, strong presence throughout the performance.
